brief: Our bike repair workshop turns away about 12 repair jobs a week because both mechanics are fully booked. We want the average wait for a repair under 5 days by the end of March, and we can't spend more than £1,500 a month extra. We could hire a part-time mechanic for about £1,300 a month, open on Sundays, or stop taking e-bike jobs, which take roughly twice as long as ordinary ones. Jo thinks Sunday opening would only spread the same work over more days. The average wait is about 9 days now.
